authority: T0 fixed-spatial-regulator instantiation of established Schrodinger Feynman-Kac, reflection-positivity, and symmetric Trotter product theorems, plus two scoped route no-gos; claim-nonbearing and not a regulator-removal, Hadamard, physical-time, light-cone, C6, CP1, or Pre-A theorem

external_authority.Feynman_Kac: B. Simon, Schrodinger semigroups, Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. 7 (1982), 447-526, DOI 10.1090/S0273-0979-1982-15041-8, for the standard finite-dimensional Schrodinger Feynman-Kac formula
external_authority.Trotter: H. F. Trotter, On the product of semi-groups of operators, Proc. AMS 10 (1959), 545-551, DOI 10.1090/S0002-9939-1959-0108732-6, together with Kato's form-sum extension
external_authority.trace_ideal_product: A. Doumeki, T. Ichinose and H. Tamura, Error bounds on exponential product formulas for Schrodinger operators, J. Math. Soc. Japan 50 (1998), 359-377, DOI 10.2969/jmsj/05020359; the shifted smooth coercive quartic lies in the p=4 confining class
external_authority.OS_context: K. Osterwalder and R. Schrader, Axioms for Euclidean Green's functions, Commun. Math. Phys. 31 (1973), 83-112; contextual only because the finite-ring reflection forms are proved directly and no full OS reconstruction is claimed
external_authority.not_supplied: the CL8 Hamiltonian, its a/8 canonical coefficient, hbar, a physical beta or ground criterion, regulator compatibility, a continuum state, a Hadamard theorem, a Lorentzian cone, or physical branch selection

statement: Fix one registered periodic CL8 spatial regulator with M>=2, d=8M, w=a/8, chi>0 and declared hbar>0. Its registered Schrodinger operator is H_a=-kappa_a Delta+U_a on L2(R^d), where kappa_a=hbar^2/(2chi w)=4hbar^2/(a chi) and U_a is a real smooth coercive quartic polynomial bounded below. For every t>0, T_t=exp(-tH_a) has a symmetric strictly positive Feynman-Kac kernel K_t, satisfies K_s*K_t=K_(s+t), and is trace class. For beta=2n epsilon, the periodic sampled-time density proportional to product_l K_epsilon(q_l,q_(l+1)) is normalized by Tr exp(-beta H_a), is reflection positive for every lattice-preserving dihedral axis through opposite sites or opposite links on the even ring, and reproduces exactly the canonical Gibbs time-ordered bounded configuration correlators at grid times; the exact kernels separately define the corresponding continuous-loop cylinder law at arbitrary ordered times. Thus a time-local Euclidean transfer and exact canonical Feynman-Kac bridge exist at every fixed spatial regulator. The ground-state Doob transform gives a compact injective reversible Markov semigroup with unbounded nonnegative logarithmic generator, not a finite-state bounded-log reconstruction. The explicit symmetric Kac/Strang slice S_epsilon=exp(-epsilon U_a/2) exp(epsilon kappa_a Delta) exp(-epsilon U_a/2) has a symmetric strictly positive trace-class kernel and an explicit Gram factorization, defines reflection-positive aligned even-ring sliced laws, and its N-fold products converge in trace norm to exp(-beta H_a), with quartic-class rate O(N^(-1/2)) locally uniformly away from beta=0. It is not the exact registered one-step semigroup: on a plateau at q=0 the epsilon-cubed coefficient is -4 kappa_a^2 w M(g+4lambda)<0. Moreover K_t(q,q')>0 for all configurations, so Euclidean heat-kernel support has no finite configuration-transition cone and cannot itself be relabelled as a Lorentzian light cone. Regulator removal, path-momentum/Weyl convergence, Hadamard form, physical beta or vacuum selection, the three-dimensional Q3 parent, energy reference, C6, CP1 and Pre-A remain open.

fixed_regulator.domain: finite M>=2, d=8M, a=L/M, w=a/8, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>=0, real r, hbar>0
fixed_regulator.potential_properties: real C-infinity polynomial, bounded below, and U_a(q)>=A_a|q|^4-B_a|q|^2 with A_a=ag/(32d)>0
fixed_regulator.energy_shift: replace U_a by U_a+C when a nonnegative potential is convenient; normalized Gibbs laws and reflection forms are unchanged

exact_heat_transfer.parameter_units: t and beta are inverse-energy parameters; if delta is physical Euclidean time, t=delta/hbar and beta=delta_beta/hbar
exact_heat_transfer.Feynman_Kac_kernel: K_t(q,q')=G_t(q,q') E_(q to q') exp[-integral_0^t U_a(B_s) ds] for the Brownian bridge with generator kappa_a Delta
properties: T_t is positive as an operator and positivity improving as a cone map
exact_heat_transfer.boundary: the temporal step t and orientation are declared inputs; the construction does not derive physical time, its arrow, or a clock calibration

ground_state_Doob_Markov_interface.ground_data: let E_0 be the simple lowest eigenvalue and psi_0(q)>0 its normalized real wavefunction
ground_state_Doob_Markov_interface.properties: P_t 1=1; P_t is positivity improving and reversible on L2(pi_a); the infinitesimal Markov generator is -L_0
ground_state_Doob_Markov_interface.unbounded_log_boundary: for t>0, P_t is compact and injective with eigenvalues accumulating at zero, has no bounded inverse, and -log(P_t)=tL_0 is unbounded on its spectral domain, in agreement with NG-2026-08-03-PRE-A-C0A-FINITE-HILBERT-BOUNDED-LOG-LIFT
ground_state_Doob_Markov_interface.boundary: this is a fixed-regulator ground-state Markov interface toward, but not an application of, the finite-state C0A bounded-log theorem; it uses the already selected ground and supplied t, is distinct from the finite-beta loop law, and does not choose a physical C0 branch

periodic_path_and_reflection_positivity.time_lattice: beta=2n epsilon with n>=1 and q_(2n)=q_0
periodic_path_and_reflection_positivity.site_reflection: splitting the even periodic ring at any lattice-preserving axis through opposite sites and conditioning on their configurations writes the reflected form as an integral of an absolute square
periodic_path_and_reflection_positivity.link_reflection: T_epsilon=T_(epsilon/2)^*T_(epsilon/2) factors each lattice-preserving reflection axis through opposite links into half-step amplitudes, again giving an absolute-square norm
periodic_path_and_reflection_positivity.positive_algebra: bounded cylinder functions of configuration multiplication observables supported on one temporal half-ring
periodic_path_and_reflection_positivity.result: the exact sampled Gibbs configuration law is reflection positive for every lattice-preserving dihedral axis through opposite sites or opposite links for every fixed M, beta and even number of time links
periodic_path_and_reflection_positivity.boundary: this is fixed-regulator thermal reflection positivity for the bounded configuration algebra on an aligned half-ring, not an odd-ring or off-grid reflection theorem and not the full continuum OS axiom package

canonical_Feynman_Kac_bridge.continuous_loop_law: the exact kernels over successive positive gaps and the closing gap define consistent finite-dimensional densities for a continuous-time periodic loop law
canonical_Feynman_Kac_bridge.ordered_correlator: for 0<=t_1<=...<=t_m<beta and bounded multipliers M_f, the continuous-loop expectation equals Z^(-1)Tr[e^{-(beta-t_m)H_a}M_(f_m)e^{-(t_m-t_(m-1))H_a}...M_(f_1)e^{-t_1H_a}]; the sampled law asserts this only at grid times t_j=m_j epsilon
canonical_Feynman_Kac_bridge.same_state: the normal density is exactly rho_(a,beta)=Z^(-1)exp(-beta H_a), already registered on B(H_a) and the regular finite CCR representation
canonical_Feynman_Kac_bridge.configuration_identification: the Euclidean time-zero marginal and all sampled ordered bounded configuration correlators equal those of the declared canonical Gibbs state
canonical_Feynman_Kac_bridge.canonical_core: on the Schwartz core, [q_i,p_j]=i hbar delta_ij, p_i=w Pi_i, [q_i,Pi_j]=i hbar delta_ij/w, and [H_a,q_i]=-i hbar p_i/(chi w)
canonical_Feynman_Kac_bridge.momentum_boundary: canonical p=-i hbar partial_q and its regular Weyl operators exist in the same registered Schrodinger representation, but the free Brownian difference quotient has mean-square norm 2d kappa_a/epsilon and diverges as epsilon tends to zero; p is not an ordinary Euclidean path variable and no regulator-limit momentum functional is proved
canonical_Feynman_Kac_bridge.ground_boundary: the beta-to-infinity trace-norm limit at fixed M is inherited from the finite-spatial-regulator quantum-state authority; beta, the ground criterion, and hbar remain declared rather than cosmologically derived

symmetric_time_slice.operator: S_epsilon=A_epsilon exp(epsilon kappa_a Delta) A_epsilon, A_epsilon=exp(-epsilon U_a/2)
symmetric_time_slice.link_Gram_factor: B_epsilon=exp(epsilon kappa_a Delta/2)A_epsilon and S_epsilon=B_epsilon^*B_epsilon; equivalently b_epsilon(z,q)=G_(epsilon/2)(z,q)exp[-epsilon U_a(q)/2] and S_epsilon(q,q')=integral b_epsilon(z,q)b_epsilon(z,q')dz
symmetric_time_slice.trace: Tr S_epsilon=(4pi kappa_a epsilon)^(-d/2) integral exp[-epsilon U_a(q)]dq<infinity
symmetric_time_slice.reflection_positivity: kernel symmetry gives the site square and the explicit Gram factor gives the link square for every lattice-preserving axis through opposite sites or links on an even periodic sliced law
symmetric_time_slice.ordering_boundary: S_epsilon is the potential-half-step companion; the literal Euclidean continuation of the inherited kinetic-half-step D-K-D order is exp(epsilon kappa_a Delta/2)exp(-epsilon U_a)exp(epsilon kappa_a Delta/2); the one-step operators differ although cyclic traces of their powers agree and both have the same Trotter limit
symmetric_time_slice.trace_theorem_hypotheses: after a scalar shift U_a+C>=c<q>^4 and |partial^alpha U_a|<=C_alpha<q>^(4-|alpha|) for 1<=|alpha|<=2; unitary coordinate rescaling handles kappa_a
symmetric_time_slice.limit: [S_(beta/N)]^N converges to exp(-beta H_a) in trace norm; after shift and coordinate rescaling the quartic p=4 Doumeki-Ichinose-Tamura theorem gives O(N^(-1/2)) locally uniformly for beta in compact subsets of (0,infinity), so partition functions and a fixed finite number of bounded inserted configuration correlators at fixed positive gaps converge
symmetric_time_slice.boundary: S_epsilon is an explicit aligned-even-ring reflection-positive approximation, not the exact one-step heat semigroup at nonzero epsilon; no odd/off-grid reflection, unbounded insertion, uniform insertion-count, or O(N^(-2)) trace-norm claim is made

one_slice_exactness_no_go.excluded_route: identify the explicit finite-epsilon symmetric Kac/Strang slice with exp[-epsilon(T+V)] merely because it is symmetric, positive, and its formal core expansion first differs at epsilon cubed
one_slice_exactness_no_go.witness: for T=-kappa d^2/dx^2, V=gamma x^4 with gamma,kappa>0, and a smooth compactly supported f equal to one near x=0, (S_epsilon-exp[-epsilon(T+V)])f(0)=-2 gamma kappa^2 epsilon^3+O(epsilon^4)
one_slice_exactness_no_go.highest_degree_sentinel: the full local epsilon-cubed coefficient on the plateau germ f=1 is -(4/3)gamma^2 kappa x^6-2gamma kappa^2, so lower-degree terms cannot erase the quartic noncommutation identically
one_slice_exactness_no_go.actual_CL8_witness: Delta^2 U_a(0)=wM(8*6g+12*16lambda)=48wM(g+4lambda)>0 and grad U_a(0)=0, hence the actual registered CL8 epsilon-cubed defect coefficient at q=0 is -4 kappa_a^2 w M(g+4lambda)<0
one_slice_exactness_no_go.retained_route: use the exact heat transfer K_epsilon or take the controlled n-to-infinity symmetric product limit

heat_support_cone_no_go.excluded_route: read a Lorentzian causal or light cone directly from support of the positive Euclidean heat transfer
heat_support_cone_no_go.witness: the free Gaussian is positive for every q,q' and the Feynman-Kac bridge weight is strictly positive, hence K_t(q,q')>0 for every t>0 and every pair of finite configurations
heat_support_cone_no_go.consequence: the Euclidean transfer has full configuration-transition support and no finite support cone
heat_support_cone_no_go.retained_route: derive a Lorentzian cone separately from real-time locality, commutator propagation, characteristic dynamics, or a controlled continuum limit

prior_art_boundary: Feynman-Kac kernels, positive heat semigroups, reflection positivity from positive transfers, Trotter product convergence, and trace-ideal convergence for smooth confining Schrodinger potentials are established mathematics. No world-first general theorem is claimed. The repository-specific result is the exact insertion of the registered CL8 a/8 Hamiltonian coefficients, the typed composition with its already registered canonical Gibbs state, and the two explicit route separations.
no_overclaim: This package closes only fixed-spatial-regulator time-local transfer, aligned-even-ring thermal configuration reflection positivity, exact bounded-configuration Feynman-Kac identification, the ground-state Doob Markov interface with an unbounded logarithmic generator, and the controlled symmetric-slice limit. It does not derive hbar, beta, the ground criterion, physical time, an arrow, an odd/off-grid reflection theorem, Lorentzian signature or light speed, a canonical momentum path variable, regulator-compatible state convergence, a continuum full Weyl or Hadamard state, a thermodynamic transition, the three-dimensional Q3 parent, a physical state or energy reference, a below-empty-space sign, C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, or Pre-A.
